name: Hydropower MRV
description: Hydropower MRV methodology aligned with Guardian Methodology Library and Verra requirements for renewable energy certificates.

steps.name: Facility Registration
steps.description: Register hydropower facility with capacity, location, and operational details

steps.name: Energy Generation Monitoring
steps.description: Submit monthly generation data including energy output, water flow, and environmental metrics

steps.description: Verify submitted data against Verra standards and methodology requirements

steps.description: Issue Renewable Energy Certificate tokens on Hedera for verified generation
